name: claude-defender-xdr
description: Claude Code plugin for Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting
author: Andrew Childs

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build. Do not edit."
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run check:plugin
scripts.check:dist: git diff --exit-code -- dist || (echo 'dist/ is stale: run npm run build and commit' && exit 1)
